d: Afghanistan—a country whose flag has been changed time and again; home to the world's oldest oil paintings and the ancient Buddha statues and caves nestled in the Hindu Kush mountains; renowned for its world-famous carpets, Kandahari embroidery, saffron, and dry fruits; and a place where the 'Attan' dance symbolizes unity and joy. There is so much more to know about Afghanistan—so come along with us on a journey to the country, right here on Infinity Stream.
